FOR nlsspanel2->Variable 1: Household roster and occupation
```{r}
Z01C<-read_dta("nlss2panel/Z01C.dta") #Activities
Z01A<-read_dta("nlss2panel/Z01A.dta") #Household roster
Z07B<-read_dta("nlss2panel/Z07B.dta") #Education
```
Rename the 'IDC' column to merge
```{r}
names(Z01C)[names(Z01C)=="V01C_IDC"] <- "IDC"
```
Merge household roster(sex,age,marital status, urban/rural) and occupation 
```{r}
merged_df<-merge(Z01A, Z01C,
                       by=c("WWW","HH","IDC"),all.x=TRUE)
dim(Z01C)
dim(Z01A)
dim(merged_df)
```
To find model values
```{r}
summary(Z01C)
summary(Z01A)
summary(Z07B)
```
Collapse to one row per person for regression
```{r}
key<-paste(merged_df$WWW, merged_df$HH, merged_df$IDC, sep="_")
merged_one<-merged_df[!duplicated(key), ]
dim(Z01A)
dim(merged_one)
```
Merge education
```{r}
Z07B_keep<-Z07B[,c("WWW","HH","IDC","V07B_02")]
merged_one <- merge(merged_one, Z07B_keep,
                    by=c("WWW","HH","IDC"),
                    all.x=TRUE)
table(merged_one$V07B_02,useNA="ifany")
```
Create a dummy variable for 'female'
```{r}
table(merged_one$V01A_02,useNA="ifany")

#Create a female dummy(female=1)
merged_one$female<-ifelse(merged_one$V01A_02==2,1,0)

#Check it
table(merged_one$female, useNA="ifany")
```
Next,let's compute labor outcomes
```{r}
#Creating a variable for calculating labor intensity
merged_one$days_month<-merged_one$V01C_03
merged_one$hours_day<-merged_one$V01C_04

merged_one$hours_month<-merged_one$days_month*merged_one$hours_day

#After calculation, let us summarize the findings
summary(merged_one$hours_month)
hist(merged_one$hours_month,main="Monthly hours worked",
     xlab="Hours Per Month")
```
Create a dummy of worked variable
```{r}
merged_one$worked_any<-ifelse(!is.na(merged_one$hours_month)&
merged_one$hours_month>0,1,0)
table(merged_one$worked_any)
```
Variable: Internet access
```{r}
Z02C2<-read_dta("nlss2panel/Z02C2.dta")#Internet access
table(Z02C2$V02C2_11F,useNA="ifany")
table(Z02C2$V02C2_11B,useNA="ifany" )
```
Creating ICT (Internet and mobile) dummies and merging
```{r}
Z02C2$internet<-ifelse(Z02C2$V02C2_11F==1,1,0)
Z02C2$mobile<-ifelse(Z02C2$V02C2_11B==1,1,0)

#Creating combined ICT(Internet or mobile)
Z02C2$ict <- ifelse(Z02C2$internet==1|Z02C2$mobile==1,1,0)

#Avoiding duplicates
Z02C2_keep<-Z02C2[,c("WWW","HH","ict")]

#Merge into merged one
merged_one<-merge(merged_one,Z02C2_keep,
                  by=c("WWW","HH"),
                  all.x=TRUE)
#Households not found
merged_one$ict[is.na(merged_one$ict)]<-0
```
Saving the processed dataset
```{r}
saveRDS(merged_one, file="processed_merged_one.rds")
write.csv(merged_one,file="processed_merged_one.csv",row.names=FALSE)
```
Performing regression
```{r}
model<-lm(worked_any~ict*female, data=merged_one)
summary(model)
table(merged_one$ict) #For individual level
```
Mean and variance of hours worked
```{r}
mean(merged_one$worked_any, na.rm=TRUE)
var(merged_one$worked_any, na.rm=TRUE)
```
Mean and variance of ict

```{r}
mean(merged_one$ict,na.rm=TRUE)
var(merged_one$ict,na.rm=TRUE)
```
Mean and variance of hrs/month
```{r}
mean(merged_one$hours_month,na.rm=TRUE)
var(merged_one$hours_month,na.rm=TRUE)
```
T-test
```{r}
t.test(worked_any~ict,data=merged_one)
```
Correlation and covariance

```{r}
numeric_vars<-merged_one[,c("worked_any","ict","female","hours_month")]

#Correlation matrix
cor(numeric_vars,use="complete.obs")

#Covariance matrix
cov(numeric_vars,use="complete.obs")
```
Scatterplot

```{r}
     merged_one$hours_month,

```

#Adding more controls and Specification
```{r}
#Age+Age^2
merged_one$age<-merged_one$V01A_05
merged_one$age2<-merged_one$age^2

#Marital status as factor
merged_one$marital<-factor(merged_one$V01A_06)

#Urban / Rural as factor
merged_one$urban<-factor(merged_one$V01A_04B)

merged_one$educ<-factor(merged_one$V07B_02)
```

Run regression with controls
```{r}
model2<-lm(worked_any~ict*female 
             +age+age2 
             +marital 
             +urban
             +educ,
             data=merged_one)
summary(model2)
```

Transformation
```{r}
merged_one$log_hours<-log(merged_one$hours_month+1)
hist(merged_one$log_hours,
     main="Monthly Hours in Log",
     xlab="Log Hours")
```

```{r}
table(merged_one$WWW)
```
For the context of nlsspanel2 data, The coefficient on ict is small and statistically insignificant, suggesting that ICT access alone does not significantly affect the probability of working. However, the interaction term between ict and female is negative, suggesting heterogeneous effects by gender, though not statistically significant

                        nlss1panel
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
Z01A_1 <- read_dta("nlss1panel/Z01A.dta")
Z01C_1 <- read_dta("nlss1panel/Z01C.dta")
Z07B_1 <- read_dta("nlss1panel/Z07B.dta")
Z02C2_1 <- read_dta("nlss1panel/Z02C2.dta")

names(Z01C_1)[names(Z01C_1) == "V01C_IDC"] <- "IDC"

# Start from person-level roster
merged_one_1 <- Z01A_1

# Education
Z07B_1_keep <- Z07B_1[, c("WWW","HH","IDC","V07B_02")]
merged_one_1 <- merge(
  merged_one_1, Z07B_1_keep,
  by = c("WWW","HH","IDC"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Female
merged_one_1$female <- ifelse(merged_one_1$V01A_02 == 2, 1, 0)

# Labor outcome from total weekly hours in Z01C_1
labor1 <- Z01C_1 %>%
  select(WWW, HH, IDC, V01C_06T) %>%
  mutate(
    hours_worked = ifelse(is.na(V01C_06T), 0, V01C_06T),
    worked_any = ifelse(!is.na(V01C_06T) & V01C_06T > 0, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(WWW, HH, IDC) %>%
  summarise(
    hours_worked = sum(hours_worked, na.rm = TRUE),
    worked_any = as.numeric(any(worked_any == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

merged_one_1 <- merge(
  merged_one_1, labor1,
  by = c("WWW","HH","IDC"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

merged_one_1$hours_worked[is.na(merged_one_1$hours_worked)] <- 0
merged_one_1$worked_any[is.na(merged_one_1$worked_any)] <- 0

# ICT
Z02C2_1$internet <- ifelse(Z02C2_1$V02C2_11F == 1, 1, 0)
Z02C2_1$mobile   <- ifelse(Z02C2_1$V02C2_11B == 1, 1, 0)
Z02C2_1$ict      <- ifelse(Z02C2_1$internet == 1 | Z02C2_1$mobile == 1, 1, 0)

Z02C2_1_keep <- Z02C2_1[, c("WWW","HH","ict")] %>% distinct()
merged_one_1 <- merge(
  merged_one_1, Z02C2_1_keep,
  by = c("WWW","HH"),
  all.x = TRUE
)
merged_one_1$ict[is.na(merged_one_1$ict)] <- 0

# Controls
merged_one_1$age     <- merged_one_1$V01A_05
merged_one_1$age2    <- merged_one_1$age^2
merged_one_1$marital <- factor(merged_one_1$V01A_06)
merged_one_1$urban   <- factor(merged_one_1$V01A_04B)
merged_one_1$educ    <- factor(merged_one_1$V07B_02)

# Panel identifiers
panel1 <- merged_one_1
panel1$wave <- 1
panel1$pid  <- paste(panel1$WWW, panel1$HH, panel1$IDC, sep = "_")

```

```{r}
# Panel 2 from NLSS2 baseline dataset
panel2 <- merged_one
panel2$wave <- 2
panel2$pid  <- paste(panel2$WWW, panel2$HH, panel2$IDC, sep = "_")
```

Correction for DiD
```{r}
# =========================
# NLSS3: use Section 11
# =========================

# Roster
Z01A_3 <- read_dta("nlss3panel/xH01_S01.dta")

# ICT
Z02C2_3 <- read_dta("nlss3panel/xH02_S02.dta")

# Education
Z07B_3 <- read_dta("nlss3panel/xH07_S06B.dta")

# Labor / hours worked (PERSON-LEVEL)
Z11_3 <- read_dta("nlss3panel/xH18_S11.dta")

# -------------------------
# Rename IDs to match
# -------------------------
names(Z01A_3)[names(Z01A_3) == "v01_idc"] <- "IDC"
names(Z07B_3)[names(Z07B_3) == "v06b_idc"] <- "IDC"
names(Z11_3)[names(Z11_3) == "v11_idc"] <- "IDC"

# -------------------------
# Build labor outcomes from S11
# -------------------------
labor3 <- Z11_3 %>%
  select(www, hh, IDC, v11_01) %>%
  mutate(
    hours_worked = ifelse(is.na(v11_01), 0, v11_01),
    worked_any = ifelse(!is.na(v11_01) & v11_01 > 0, 1, 0)
  )

# -------------------------
# Build ICT from Section 2
# -------------------------
Z02C2_3$internet <- ifelse(Z02C2_3$v02_31d == 1, 1, 0)
Z02C2_3$mobile   <- ifelse(Z02C2_3$v02_31b == 1, 1, 0)
Z02C2_3$ict      <- ifelse(Z02C2_3$internet == 1 | Z02C2_3$mobile == 1, 1, 0)

ict3 <- Z02C2_3 %>%
  select(www, hh, ict) %>%
  distinct()

# -------------------------
# Education
# -------------------------
educ3 <- Z07B_3 %>%
  select(www, hh, IDC, v06_04)

# -------------------------
# Merge panel 3 person-level data
# -------------------------
panel3 <- Z01A_3 %>%
  left_join(labor3, by = c("www", "hh", "IDC")) %>%
  left_join(educ3,  by = c("www", "hh", "IDC")) %>%
  left_join(ict3,   by = c("www", "hh"))

# Replace missing values
panel3$ict[is.na(panel3$ict)] <- 0
panel3$worked_any[is.na(panel3$worked_any)] <- 0
panel3$hours_worked[is.na(panel3$hours_worked)] <- 0

# Controls
panel3$female  <- ifelse(panel3$v01_02 == 2, 1, 0)
panel3$urban   <- factor(panel3$v01_04)
panel3$educ    <- factor(panel3$v06_04)
panel3$age     <- panel3$v01_05a
panel3$age2    <- panel3$age^2
panel3$marital <- factor(panel3$v01_06)

# Standardize names for combining
panel3$wave <- 3
panel3$pid  <- paste(panel3$www, panel3$hh, panel3$IDC, sep = "_")
names(panel3)[names(panel3) == "www"] <- "WWW"
names(panel3)[names(panel3) == "hh"]  <- "HH"

# Quick checks
table(panel3$worked_any, useNA = "ifany")
summary(panel3$hours_worked)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Rebuild panel_all
# =========================

# Make sure panel1 and panel2 already exist
# and that they have these variables:
# WWW, HH, IDC, pid, wave, worked_any, ict, female, age, age2, marital, urban, educ

common_vars <- c(
  "WWW","HH","IDC","pid","wave",
  "worked_any","ict","female","age","age2","marital","urban","educ"
)

panel1_small <- panel1[, common_vars]
panel2_small <- panel2[, common_vars]
panel3_small <- panel3[, common_vars]

panel_all <- rbind(panel1_small, panel2_small, panel3_small)

# Check worked_any by wave
panel_all %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_worked = mean(worked_any, na.rm = TRUE),
    ict_rate = mean(ict, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# =========================
# DiD setup
# =========================

panel_all$post <- ifelse(panel_all$wave >= 2, 1, 0)
panel_all$did  <- panel_all$ict * panel_all$post

model_df <- panel_all[, c("pid","wave","worked_any","did","age","age2","marital","urban","educ")]
model_df <- na.omit(model_df)

summary(model_df$worked_any)
table(is.finite(model_df$worked_any), useNA = "ifany")

# Pooled OLS DiD
m1 <- lm(
  worked_any ~ did + age + age2 + marital + urban + educ,
  data = model_df
)
summary(m1)

# Wave fixed effects
m2 <- feols(
  worked_any ~ did + age + age2 + marital + urban + educ | wave,
  data = model_df,
  cluster = ~pid
)
summary(m2)

# Individual + wave FE on balanced sample
pid_counts <- table(model_df$pid)
model_df_bal <- model_df[model_df$pid %in% names(pid_counts[pid_counts >= 2]), ]

m3 <- feols(
  worked_any ~ did + age + age2 + marital + urban + educ | pid + wave,
  data = model_df_bal,
  cluster = ~pid
)
summary(m3)
```
